name: At random Full
summary: This EA opens trades at random — it generates random buy or sell signals and places market orders with no technical analysis or indicator-based logic. It is essentially a random entry trading system that relies on probability rather than market analysis for trade decisions.
summary_zh: 该EA随机开仓——生成随机买入或卖出信号并无分析地直接下单。它本质上是一个随机入场交易系统，完全依赖概率而非市场分析来决定交易方向。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略概念是纯随机入场，不依赖任何技术指标或市场结构分析。入场条件完全由随机数生成器决定，随机选择买入或卖出方向。出场条件可能包含止损和止盈设置，但入场本身没有任何逻辑依据。仓位管理方面，EA可能使用固定手数或基于资金的仓位计算方式。资金管理方面，由于策略本身缺乏方向性逻辑，风险控制完全依赖止损止盈参数的设置。整体而言，该EA属于实验性质或概念验证性质的交易程序，不具备实际盈利能力的理论基础。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy concept of this EA is purely random entry, relying on no technical indicators or market structure analysis whatsoever. Entry conditions are determined entirely by a random number generator, randomly selecting between buy and sell directions. Exit conditions likely include stop loss and take profit settings, but the entry itself has no logical basis. Position sizing may use fixed lots or account-balance-based calculation. Money management depends entirely on stop loss and take profit parameter configuration since the strategy itself lacks directional logic. Overall, this EA is experimental or proof-of-concept in nature and lacks any theoretical foundation for actual profitability.
pros: 代码简洁，逻辑清晰，适合初学者理解EA基本结构
可作为概率论和随机交易的理论验证工具
不存在过拟合问题，因为策略不依赖历史数据
无需任何技术指标，计算开销极低
pros_en: Simple and clear code structure, suitable for beginners learning EA fundamentals
Can serve as a theoretical validation tool for probability and random trading studies
No overfitting risk since the strategy does not rely on historical data
No technical indicators required, minimal computational overhead
cons: 策略完全缺乏市场分析基础，长期必然亏损
随机入场等同于赌博，不具备任何可验证的统计优势
缺少滑点和点差过滤机制，在不利条件下会频繁亏损
没有新K线检查机制，可能在同一根K线上反复开仓
缺乏仓位验证和持仓检查，可能产生意外重复下单
cons_en: Strategy completely lacks market analysis foundation, guaranteed long-term loss
Random entry is equivalent to gambling with no verifiable statistical edge
No slippage or spread filter mechanism, frequent losses under adverse conditions
No new bar check, may repeatedly open positions on the same bar
Lacks position verification and holding checks, may produce unintended duplicate orders
improvements: 增加技术指标过滤条件，仅在趋势方向一致时随机入场，提高胜率
添加新K线检查和持仓检查机制，避免重复开仓和过度交易
加入点差过滤和滑点保护，减少不利交易环境下的损失
improvements_en: Add technical indicator filters — only enter randomly when aligned with trend direction to improve win rate
Add new bar check and position check mechanisms to prevent duplicate entries and overtrading
Add spread filter and slippage protection to reduce losses in unfavorable trading conditions

risk_points: 纯随机入场无任何市场分析，等同于赌博
可能缺少止损设置，面临无限亏损风险
无新K线检查可能导致短时间大量重复开仓
risk_points_en: Pure random entry with no market analysis is equivalent to gambling
May lack stop loss setting, facing unlimited loss risk
No new bar check may cause massive duplicate positions in short time

summary_en: This EA opens trades at random — it generates random buy or sell signals and places market orders with no technical analysis or indicator-based logic. It is essentially a random entry trading system that relies on probability rather than market analysis for trade decisions.
